description: This file defines the UploadMultipleFiles class which manages multi-file uploads, including handling security checks, mime type detection, file renaming, moving, duplication, external API upload, and error handling within a SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: UploadMultipleFiles
classes.description: A class that encapsulates functionality related to uploading multiple files, including validation, malware scanning, storage, and external API interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload handler with a specific form field name and index.

methods.name: set_for_soap
methods.description: Sets up the object for SOAP-based file uploads with a specified filename and file content.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Returns a URL path for a document based on stored filename and bean ID (deprecated).

methods.name: get_upload_url
methods.description: Generates a URL to download the uploaded document related to a specific record.

methods.name: tryRename
methods.description: Attempts to rename a file in the upload directory using a bean ID.

methods.name: get_file_path
methods.description: Builds a URL path for referencing a stored file, with optional renaming.

methods.name: duplicate_file
methods.description: Duplicates an existing uploaded file within the filesystem, handling different naming conventions.

methods.name: get_upload_error
methods.description: Retrieves the upload error code for the current file.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Performs security and validity checks to confirm the upload's integrity and success.

methods.name: getMimeSoap
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type for a file in a SOAP context.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of an uploaded file based on its properties.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the filename stored in the system.

methods.name: get_temp_file_location
methods.description: Returns the temporary location of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_uploaded_file_name
methods.description: Returns the original filename of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: get_file_contents
methods.description: Returns the contents of the uploaded file.

methods.name: create_stored_filename
methods.description: Generates a sanitized filename for storage, handling special cases like Windows filesystems.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded temporary file to its final storage location, identified by bean ID.

methods.name: upload_doc
methods.description: Uploads the document to an external API service if applicable, handling errors and renaming.

methods.name: get_upload_path
methods.description: Returns the path for uploading a file based on the bean ID.

methods.name: unlink_file
methods.description: Deletes a file given its bean ID and filename.

methods.name: get_upload_dir
methods.description: Returns the prefix path for uploaded files.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Resolves the real filesystem path for a given upload path.

methods.name: relativeName
methods.description: Returns the filename relative to the uploads directory.
